cohort: Pregnant women planned for induction of labor at 40 weeks gestation with no medical comorbidities or contraindications for vaginal birth.
finding: Transvaginal sonography of cervical length demonstrates higher accuracy in predicting successful induction of labor compared to the digital Bishop Score.
mod_finding: Women who delivered via C-section had a higher mean age and higher mean sonographic cervical length compared to those who achieved vaginal birth.
cross-section timing: At 40 weeks gestation, prior to the induction of labor.
